text:
maria: Heads-up — our GPU commitment window opens in ~28 days for several SKUs (us-west-2 primarily). Need a quick plan for p4d/p5a usage vs committed coverage. :eyes:

ops-bot: Automated summary: GPU SavingsPlan monitor
- Region: us-west-2
- SKU p4d.24xlarge: committed=120 units, avg_used=102 units (85%), 30d projected shortfall=18 units
- SKU p5a.48xlarge: committed=64 units, avg_used=38 units (59%), projected excess=26 units
- Estimated on-demand risk next 30d if unchanged: ~$120,000
- Note: tag drift detected on ~9% of GPU hours (unattributed projects)

jeff: Quick q — are the p5a numbers driven by a single team burst or steady low usage?

sara: p5a is mostly inference clusters from 'search-service' and a few new infra experiments not in prod. Usage is spiky; baseline is low. we could reduce committed there without affecting latency.

trevor: For p4d the 85% utilization is decent, but projected shortfall matters for peak training windows. Options: 1) top-up small extra commitment, 2) rely on on-demand/spot for spikes, 3) convert some p4d to convertible RI for flexibility.

maria: Finance needs clear cost delta for each option. lena — any headroom in renewal budget? @lena

lena: finance-bot already posted last week but TL;DR: budgeted renewal pool = $100k/mo. Anything above needs CFO sign-off. We can approve up to $100k with a short justification doc.

jeff: I ran a quick query against billing export to validate ops-bot numbers:
```sql
SELECT sku, SUM(ifnull(usage_amount,0)) AS hours, SUM(ifnull(reserved_hours,0)) AS reserved_hours
FROM `billing.gpu_usage_*`
WHERE invoice_month = '2025-11' AND region = 'us-west-2'
GROUP BY sku
ORDER BY hours DESC;
```
Results match within ~3% of the bot. Tag drift is real.

sara: There's also a set of short-lived training jobs in eu-west-1 that weren't tagged -> they show up as on-demand and lower us-west-2 utilization in our forecasts. I'll start a small cleanup job to enforce tags and add an alert.

maria: Proposed concrete options (vote please):
A) Keep p4d at current level, reduce p5a commit by 40% (savings ~ $75k/yr), accept some on-demand for spikes.
B) Keep p4d, convert 25% of p5a to Convertible SP (more flexibility) and buy smaller upfront RI for steady baseline.
C) Increase p4d by 15 units to cover shortfall, keep p5a as-is, pay extra now to avoid on-demand premium.

trevor: My preference: B. Convertible gives us the flexibility to re-target if infra experiments fail. Also pursue tag cleanup to reclaim orphaned usage for coverage.

jeff: B + short term spot autoscale for non-critical workloads. We should also set a canary: if p4d avg > 110 units for 7 consecutive days, auto-propose an addendum.

ops-bot: Action items created: #infra-savings/1992456789 -> owners: sara (tag clean), jeff (query + alert), trevor (conversion proposal), lena (finance sign-off doc).

maria: @lena can finance pre-approve a split-purchase (some convertible + some upfront) or do we need separate approvals?

lena: We can pre-approve up to $100k for mixed purchases if engineering provides a short ROI estimate (1 paragraph) + migration risk. Anything >$100k needs CFO.

jeff: ROI sketch: converting 25% of p5a reduces stranded spend and gives reallocation flexibility; expected savings 10-15% over 12 months vs all-on-demand fallback. I'll draft the paragraph.

sara: I'll get tag enforcement scheduled today and post results in this thread in 48h.

maria: Great. Let's reconvene after jeff and trevor post the conversion numbers. If consensus is B, we'll prepare the finance packet and aim to execute before the window closes. :thumbsup:

finance-bot: Reminder: renewal windows are time-boxed. Submit final commit decisions at least 7 business days before expiration to avoid partial coverage.
